title: Large single-file query engine reduces maintainability
evidence: src/query.ts is 774 lines (SoccerQueries holds matches/teams/players/standings/stats/players all in one class); src/tools.ts 574, src/data.ts 498. maintainability=0.3357 from scores.json.
suggestion: Split SoccerQueries into match/team/player/competition modules; keep per-file under ~500 lines.

title: Tool surface exceeds the spec's required capabilities
evidence: src/tools.ts registers 17 tools including team_rankings, compare_seasons, derbies, team_profile, cup_bracket, cup_finals, club_player_summary beyond the spec's match/team/player/competition/stats asks.
suggestion: None — surfacing as enhancement beyond spec, not a deduction.

title: Cross-file knowledge-graph linking and data-quality handling
evidence: src/data.ts merges duplicate fixtures across 5 match files (mergeMatches), infers Brazilian clubs and links FIFA players to match-data teams (loadPlayers), and handles COVID-delayed 2020 season boundary (data.ts:286).
suggestion: None — robustness beyond the minimum spec.

title: FIFA-19 licensing gaps surfaced to the user instead of empty results
evidence: src/query.ts:696 searchPlayers pushes a note listing available Brazilian clubs when a requested club (e.g. Flamengo) is absent from fifa_data.csv.

title: ATDD/test-quality score moderate under neutral prompt
evidence: _atdd_review.json score=0.6071 (ratings A2 B2 C3 D1 E2 F3 G4); neutral prompt prescribes no methodology, so tests favour direct query-function assertions over behaviour-focused executable specifications.
suggestion: None required by spec; noted for cross-prompt comparison (neutral vs atdd-skill).
